new_processes.name: Meeting coordination
new_processes.definition: Announcing, scheduling and confirming attendance at recurring group, industry and staff meetings.

new_processes.name: Decremental bidding process
new_processes.definition: Defining and settling decremental bids in the ISO supplemental energy market and capturing the revenue.

new_processes.name: Deal entry inquiry
new_processes.definition: Answering questions about deals entered in Enpower, such as counterparty and entry accuracy.

new_processes.name: EES real-time deal spreadsheet distribution
new_processes.definition: Sending real-time deal spreadsheets to EES recipients and maintaining the recipient list.
